body.name: Two-stage selective holdout design
body.construction: For \(\rho\in I\) and a fixed \(B_n\), construct \(Y^{(h)}\), draw the independent stratumwise holdouts, completely randomize stage one in every stratum \(s\in S\), observe \(Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}\), compute \(X_{n,s}(\rho)\), and realize \(C_n(\rho)\) and \(\mathcal F_{n,1}(\rho)\). Then recruit exactly the strata with \(C_{n,s}(\rho)=1\) and, conditional on that history, draw stage two independently by complete randomization only in those strata. This chronological construction is \(\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\).
